about_the_game:
Dodge, catch, and click to the beat in this fast-paced action rhythm game, where precision and movement are key!

  • Avoid Echoes, Catch Rebounders, and tap on Pulse notes.

  • Pay Attention - Charts can get fast, read their patterns as you play!

  • Limited Mistakes - If you don't pay attention, you might lose HP and will have to restart!

  • Gameplay Modifiers - Is a chart too hard for you? Do you just want to learn it to get a full combo later? Don't worry, you can check out modifiers to slow down the game, disable failing... Want to make it harder instead? You can do that too!

  • Compete With Others - Gain Echo Points by completing charts, and see how you rank amongst others!

  • Steam Workshop Support - Create your own charts directly in the game and share them!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD FX series
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+ or Vulkan-capable GPU
  • Storage: 190 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 25.04 LTS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060+ / AMD RX 580+ (with Vulkan support)
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
